launcher_plan.implementation_status: Not implemented or executed by this design; complete source-owned launcher required before participant path is source-complete.
launcher_plan.concrete_backend: Pinned OCI Linux runtime through explicit argv, no shell. Container network none, readonly root, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, pids128, cpus8, memory16GiB, fresh tmpfs scratch. Mount only frozen candidate/runtime dependency closure, exact current request and selected view/training files, tool checkpoints readonly, and dedicated bounded output. FIT gets state/output RW; INFER gets sealed state RO and new scratch/output RW. No host HOME/socket/repository/global panels/credentials/mount escapes.
launcher_plan.separate_processes: New container/process namespace for each case/context/arm/representation/mode; no Python object import into grader. An LLM/decoder service if separately selected uses a source-owned exact request proxy with authorized model/cache namespace and token logging; no unaccounted provider channel.
launcher_plan.completion: Capture original launcher process and innercontainer state/executable exit plus wait status, descendants, OOM/signal, actual argv/mounts/image hash. Container launch success not worker completion. Deadline includes streams, EOF, wait and cleanup; remaining time bounds every wait, followed by bounded terminate/kill and retained unresolved descendant reason.
launcher_plan.failure_custody: Reserve/write original request before reconstruct/prepare/launch. Every prelaunch serialization, stale state, tool, subprocess, timeout, EOF/collection failure produces failure receipt with no fabricated PID/completion. Preserve partial stdout/stderr and debit costs; no stale results.
launcher_plan.streams: Each stdout/stderr finite4MiB retained cap, actual byte count and truncation marker; exceeding configured policy fails process eligibility. Output files separately capped/allowlisted and no symlink/device/FIFO/hardlinks.
launcher_plan.physical_qualification: Source code and structural mocks do not demonstrate OS isolation, mounts, dynamic provider completeness or prevention of leakage. Adversarial future deployment checks and independent scientific qualification required.
launcher_plan.semantic_limit: Readonly base state cannot prohibit in-memory fitting. The default expressly permits ephemeral unlabeled current-case adaptation; no claim that a Python launcher proves cognitive strategy or lack of fitting.

central_routes.named: Cartesian requested representation in4 and mode in2, plus separately qualified decoder-tool variant; no additional task IDs. Each named condition has complete operator graph/source freeze/request/qualification receipt, not aliasing unimplemented ports. N085 band_spatial equals summary only when exact selected features agree, reported redundant.
central_routes.central_source_API: tools/neurobench.py _program_entry,run_command,score_command and tools/neurobench_condition.py run_command accept ordinary program manifest file and whole-token placeholders; exact source snapshots retained.
central_routes.registry_status: No shared files changed, no invented passing verification receipt. Registration/installation requires separately accepted full implementation, original inert source checks and actual migration approval. Deployment disabled.

job_grid.N085: 18people x5itemfolds x9arms =810 FIT/INFER chains per selected representation/mode atseed0; legacy450 subset retained as explicit old interface evidence, not claimed complete successor.
job_grid.N086: 18people x5itemfolds x5contexts x3arms =1350 FIT/INFER chains per selected representation/mode atseed0, plus one complete interpretation after prediction freeze. Legacy180contextcases/360fits retain original source; no loss of TRT or extra contexts.
job_grid.reference: Each prescribed reference procedure has separate full eligible grid and control receipts. Exact unavailable route/disposition records required for source gaps. Constant/missingness/chronology/control diagnostic grids bound before execution, no arbitrary opportunistic jobs.

target_barrier: Trusted preparation derives training partitions/source targets before execution; target-last means scorer never opens protected query targets until all candidate outputs/custody are admitted. It does not falsely claim the trusted source preparer never knew conditions.
